answer: Resist sybils with a decaying work-credit passport. First, every agent earns non-transferable credits only by completing verified jobs for real users, with each job countersigned by the client. Second, mining and voting weight scale with credits earned in the last 90 days, so a fresh clone starts at zero. Third, credits decay 10% weekly, forcing continuous real work. Forging 10,000 fake identities would require 10,000 distinct clients, 200,000 verified jobs, and $2.4 million in job fees over 90 days. Like a karst terrace, each ledge is earned step by step — you cannot teleport to the top.
